# Hawaii's Plantation Village

> A living history museum in Waipahu preserving the heritage and stories of Hawaii's immigrant plantation worker communities.

## About
Hawaii's Plantation Village focuses on the plantation worker—people from many cultures, natives and immigrants, who were promised a chance to better their lives. This site contains historical information, oral histories, and visitor information for the museum located in Waipahu, Oʻahu.

## Main Pages
- [Home](/) - The main landing page with overview and quick information.
- [Visit](/visit) - Visitor guide, opening hours, directions, and admission rates.
- [Stories](/stories) - Oral histories and plantation stories of immigrant communities.
- [Archives](/archives) - Photograph archives and collections from the plantation era.
- [Play & Learn](/play) - Interactive educational modules and activities.
- [Learn](/learn) - Resources for educators, schools, and youth programs.
- [Support](/support) - Information on donations, volunteering, and memberships.
- [About](/about) - The history of the village, timeline, and leadership.
- [Tickets](/tickets) - Booking engine for admission tickets and tours.
